description: Raw lines of the two adversaries run against the policy of Rabbit and against Landlock and seccomp on Linux, cut from one CI log. summary.csv and totals.csv are derived from the four .log files by bench/policy/build_table.py.

steps.rabbit: Run the adversary and the compromised binary against Rabbit

linux_runner.landlock_abi_source: landlock=abi8 on the line `CHILD AGENT policy` of linux-adversary.log and linux-compromised.log
linux_runner.udp_port_rules: off, from the same line: they need Landlock ABI 10

rabbit_qemu.qemu_package: qemu-system-x86 1:10.2.1+ds-1ubuntu3.3, installed by the step `Install QEMU`
rabbit_qemu.cpu: not recorded (the command has no -cpu option)
rabbit_qemu.accel: not recorded (the command has no -accel option)
rabbit_qemu.network: virtio-net-pci with the user mode network; the log shows the guest addresses 10.0.2.2 (allowed) and 10.0.2.3 (another)

rabbit-adversary.log.note: The step prints only the first 60 lines of the ADV and POLICY lines of the boot: the 21 named cases and the first 21 rows of the enumerated family are there, the summary line is not. The family of this setup is not recorded.

rabbit-compromised.log.note: every RAW line, the summary and the gap line of the boot

linux-adversary.log.note: the adversary test with its ADV net and GAP lines

linux-compromised.log.note: the compromised test with its RAW net and GAP lines

not_in_the_log: the hash of the Rabbit kernel and of the archives
the summary line and the family rows after the 21st of the adversary boot of Rabbit
